reset_decode_review: CaptureResetCause reads RCC PINRST into bit1, logs as PIN RESET, and clears RCC reset flags at startup. 0x2 is the application mask, not raw RCC CSR. No application/core NVIC_SystemReset call found in source search.
conclusion: Do not attribute reset to direct DTR/RTS-to-NRST wiring given the user report. Actual MCU reboot confirmed by uptime + startup log; electrical path and any relationship to Jetson ch34x warning remain undetermined. No firmware/driver/ROS parameter changes.
